mapper.update: UPDATE user_quota SET used_bytes = used_bytes + #{bytes}, file_count = file_count + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_quota SET used_bytes = IF(used_bytes >= #{bytes}, used_bytes - #{bytes}, 0), file_count = GREATEST(file_count - 1, 0) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_quota SET used_bytes = used_bytes + #{bytes}, file_count = file_count + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND used_bytes + reserved_bytes + #{bytes} <= total_bytes
UPDATE user_quota SET reserved_bytes = reserved_bytes + #{bytes}, reserved_file_count = reserved_file_count + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND used_bytes + reserved_bytes + #{bytes} <= total_bytes

UPDATE user_quota SET reserved_bytes = reserved_bytes - #{bytes}, reserved_file_count = GREATEST(reserved_file_count - 1, 0), used_bytes = used_bytes + #{bytes}, file_count = file_count + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND reserved_bytes >= #{bytes}
UPDATE user_quota SET reserved_bytes = IF(reserved_bytes >= #{bytes}, reserved_bytes - #{bytes}, 0), reserved_file_count = GREATEST(reserved_file_count - 1, 0) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
